elements.name: require(bool,string)(now > validAfter,FiatTokenV2: authorization is not yet valid)

issues.description:
EIP3009._requireValidAuthorization(address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (CDCETH_implementation.sol#1744-1756) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- require(bool,string)(now > validAfter,FiatTokenV2: authorization is not yet valid) (CDCETH_implementation.sol#1750-1753)
	- require(bool,string)(now < validBefore,FiatTokenV2: authorization is expired) (CDCETH_implementation.sol#1754)
